messages.subject: Interactive GUI to install packages no longer works
messages.subject_clean: Interactive GUI to install packages no longer works
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

For some reason (unexplained), I can no longer use the button to 'Install packages'. Selecting this causes the program to display  utils:::menuInstallPkgs()  on the command line, but then not respond further. Other similar interactive GUI commands ('chooseCRANmirror()', 'setRepositories()') exhibit a similar behaviour: no response, I have to end the session and start a new one.

Can you suggest a solution?

Thanks,
Len

messages.subject: Problem with Rterm in Tinn-R with R 3.2.3
messages.subject_clean: Problem with Rterm in Tinn-R with R 3.2.3
messages.body_plain:
Hi,
Yesterday I updated my R version with the last version 3.2.3, and now when I open Rterm from Tinn-R Rterm "console" does not update the commads, and at the same time it opens a Rgui console where it displays the results of the commands from the Rterm.
On the other side Rgui keeps on working fine.
Anyone else has had this problem?
Thanks in advance,
F.

messages.subject: Problem with Rterm using debug library and mtrace function
messages.subject_clean: Problem with Rterm using debug library and mtrace function
messages.body_plain:
Hello,
I've found that when I'm using debug package and funcion mtrace() with rterm, I can not print or in fact give any command to Rterm. When I try to do it looks like Rterm clips the first character of the command, print(a1) returns Error in eval(expr, envir, enclos) : could not find function "rint". I've found that if I write pprint(x) it works fine, but don't know what happens with the send to Rterm option.
Nevertheless when I do the same in Rgui instead of Rterm, it works fine.
Looks like there's a problem in the connetion between Tinn-R and Rterm that does not occur with Rgui
Maybe there's something wrong with my server connections in any case because when I open Rgui many times it takes some time to load sgInfo.R and open the SocketServer, and it pops up an error that TinnCom package is not found, I only have to wait a bit till it is loaded and the connections are set, so it works again.
Any clue what's happening?
Thanks a lot in advance.
Fran
